author: Retro Game Corps
description:
The Anbernic RG Rotate is a unique form factor, with a clever swivel hinge that sets it apart from the pack. Let's take a look at the good and bad so far.

The device isn't up for sale yet, I'll add links when they are available.

Recommended USB dongles:
Odyssey Retro (AliExpress): https://s.click.aliexpress.com/e/_c3cDke6f
Odyssey Retro (direct): https://www.veclan.com/engappliance_sel_one?eng_ApplianceVo.eac_id=4
UGREEN dongle: https://amzn.to/42lzDKv

This was a review unit sent to me by the manufacturer.  All opinions are my own, they did not see this review ahead of time, and no money was exchanged in any way.
